import sys,resource,signal,time,json
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
sys.path[:0]=["scripts","peano-lab/py"]
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(170,175));signal.alarm(180)
start=time.monotonic();cpu=time.process_time()
old=json.loads(Path("research/arithmetic-library/working/alpha-v34-release-v1/publication-preflight-observations-v1.json").read_text())
paths=list(old["final_owned_implementation_pins"])
def pins():
    return {p:{"bytes":len(Path(p).read_bytes()),"sha256":sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in paths}
before=pins()
import pytest
import constructive_alpha_v34_publication_process as process
held=tuple(case for phase in process.PHASES for case in process.expected_test_ids(phase))
class Ledger:
    def __init__(self): self.ids=();self.passed=[];self.held=[];self.bad=[];self.phases=[]
    def pytest_collection_finish(self,session): self.ids=tuple(item.nodeid for item in session.items)
    def pytest_deselected(self,items): self.held.extend(item.nodeid for item in items)
    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self,report):
        self.phases.append((report.nodeid,report.when,report.outcome))
        if report.failed or report.skipped or hasattr(report,"wasxfail"): self.bad.append(report.nodeid)
        if report.when=="call" and report.passed: self.passed.append(report.nodeid)
ledger=Ledger()
args=["-q","--tb=short","scripts/test_verify_peano_library_channels_v34.py","scripts/test_constructive_research_publication_source_v34.py","scripts/test_constructive_gcd_congruence_explorer_v34.py","scripts/test_constructive_polynomial_gcd_definitions_v34.py","peano-lab/py/tests/test_constructive_alpha_v34_publication_process.py","peano-lab/py/tests/test_constructive_research_publication_v34.py"]
for case in held: args.extend(["--deselect",case])
status=int(pytest.main(args,plugins=[ledger]))
assert status==0 and len(ledger.ids)==649 and len(set(ledger.ids))==649
assert tuple(ledger.passed)==ledger.ids and not ledger.bad
assert len(ledger.held)==171 and set(ledger.held)==set(held)
assert len(ledger.phases)==1947 and all(outcome=="passed" for _,_,outcome in ledger.phases)
after=pins();assert after==before
assert not any("editions_v" in name or "alpha_enrollment_v" in name for name in sys.modules)
peak=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss;peak=int(peak if sys.platform=="darwin" else peak*1024);assert peak<=1536*1024*1024
print(json.dumps({"status":status,"cases":649,"passed_phases":1947,"same_live_phase_cases_held":171,"same_live_ordered_ids_sha256":sha256(("\n".join(held)+"\n").encode()).hexdigest(),"ordered_test_ids_sha256":sha256(("\n".join(ledger.ids)+"\n").encode()).hexdigest(),"elapsed_seconds":time.monotonic()-start,"cpu_seconds":time.process_time()-cpu,"peak_rss_bytes":peak,"alpha_imports":[],"all_owned_sources_unchanged":True,"source_pins":after}),flush=True)
PY
